ko.title: 주 의사당 뒷이야기: 기술 산업 로비스트들이 미국의 새 AI 챗봇 법을 어떻게 형성하는가

segments.src: ## A Wave of State Action Follows Tragedy
segments.tr: ## 비극 이후 이어지는 주 차원의 행동 물결

segments.src: Over the past year, state legislatures across the country have moved with unusual speed to regulate AI chatbots, particularly those marketed as companions or emotional-support tools for young users.
segments.tr: 지난 1년간 전국의 주 입법부들은 청소년을 대상으로 마케팅되는 반려자나 정서 지원 도구를 포함한 AI 챗봇을 규제하기 위해 이례적인 속도로 움직였다.

segments.src: The push follows a string of deeply troubling cases in which families have alleged that chatbot interactions played a role in a teenager's death by suicide.
segments.tr: 이러한 움직임은 가족들이 챗봇과의 상호작용이 청소년의 자살 원인이 되었다고 주장하는 일련의 심각한 사건들에 따른 것이다.

segments.src: Those cases, several of which are now the subject of civil lawsuits, have turned what was once a niche policy conversation among AI researchers into a mainstream legislative priority.
segments.tr: 이 사건들은 그 중 몇 건이 현재 민사소송의 대상이 되고 있으며, AI 연구자들 사이의 틈새 정책 논의를 주류 입법 우선순위로 전환시켰다.

segments.src: By recent counts, roughly 15 states have introduced or advanced legislation aimed at chatbot safety — measures that range from mandatory crisis-referral protocols and age-verification requirements to disclosure rules requiring bots to clearly identify themselves as non-human.
segments.tr: 최근 집계에 따르면 약 15개 주가 챗봇 안전을 목표로 하는 입법을 제안하거나 진행 중이며, 이러한 조치는 필수 위기 상담 의뢰 프로토콜과 나이 인증 요구 사항에서부터 봇이 자신을 명확히 인간이 아님으로 식별하도록 요구하는 공개 규칙까지 다양하다.

segments.src: Lawmakers in both parties have described the effort as an urgent, bipartisan response to a technology that is evolving faster than the legal system meant to oversee it.
segments.tr: 양 진영의 의원들은 이러한 노력을 법적 시스템이 감시할 수 있는 속도보다 빠르게 진화하는 기술에 대한 긴급하고 초당적인 대응이라고 설명했다.

segments.src: ## Where Industry Involvement Comes In
segments.tr: ## 산업 참여의 개입

segments.src: What has drawn fresh scrutiny is not the existence of these bills, but how some of them are being written.
segments.tr: 새로운 검토의 대상이 된 것은 이러한 법안의 존재가 아니라 그 중 일부가 어떻게 작성되고 있는지이다.

segments.src: Journalists and policy researchers who have reviewed lobbying disclosures and draft legislative language in several states report that major technology companies — including Google and other large AI developers — have been actively engaged in shaping the bills, not just opposing them outright.
segments.tr: 여러 주의 로비 공개 정보와 입법안 초안을 검토한 언론인과 정책 연구자들은 Google을 포함한 대형 기술 회사들과 다른 대규모 AI 개발자들이 법안에 단순히 반대하는 것이 아니라 적극적으로 법안 형성에 참여하고 있다고 보도했다.

segments.src: According to this reporting, the industry's approach has often centered less on blocking regulation altogether and more on negotiating the fine print: definitions of what counts as a "companion chatbot," carve-outs for general-purpose assistants, and exemption clauses that determine which products actually fall under a given law's scope.
segments.tr: 이 보도에 따르면, 산업의 접근 방식은 규제를 완전히 차단하는 것보다는 세부사항 협상에 중점을 두었다: "반려자 챗봇"으로 간주되는 것의 정의, 범용 어시스턴트에 대한 제외, 특정 법의 범위에 실제로 해당하는 제품을 결정하는 면제 조항.

segments.src: Critics argue that this kind of technical drafting can be just as consequential as a bill's headline provisions, since narrow or ambiguous definitions can leave the most widely used consumer AI products largely untouched even as smaller, less-resourced companion-app makers face the full weight of new compliance rules.
segments.tr: 비평가들은 이러한 기술적 초안이 법안의 핵심 조항만큼 중요할 수 있다고 주장한다. 왜냐하면 좁거나 모호한 정의는 가장 널리 사용되는 소비자 AI 제품을 대부분 그대로 두면서 더 작고 리소스가 부족한 반려자 앱 제작자들이 새로운 규정 준수의 전체 무게를 감당하게 하기 때문이다.

segments.src: Industry representatives have pushed back on characterizations that suggest improper influence.
segments.tr: 산업 대표들은 부당한 영향을 시사하는 특성화에 대해 이의를 제기했다.

segments.src: Trade groups representing major tech firms have said their involvement in the legislative process is standard practice for any regulated industry, and that technical input from companies with deep engineering expertise helps lawmakers avoid writing rules that are unworkable, vague, or that inadvertently sweep in unrelated software like customer-service bots, search features, or productivity tools.
segments.tr: 대형 기술 기업을 대표하는 무역 단체들은 입법 과정에서의 참여가 규제 대상이 되는 모든 산업의 표준 관행이라고 말했으며, 깊은 엔지니어링 전문성을 가진 회사들의 기술적 의견은 의원들이 작동하지 않거나 모호하거나 고객 서비스 봇, 검색 기능, 생산성 도구와 같은 무관한 소프트웨어를 무심코 포함하는 규칙을 작성하는 것을 피할 수 있도록 도와준다고 했다.

segments.src: Several companies have publicly stated they support "reasonable safeguards" for minors and have pointed to product changes — such as updated crisis-response prompts and parental controls — as evidence of good-faith efforts to address the underlying concerns independent of legislation.
segments.tr: 여러 회사들은 미성년자를 위한 "합리적인 보안 조치"를 지원한다고 공개적으로 밝혔으며, 업데이트된 위기 대응 프롬프트 및 부모 통제와 같은 제품 변경을 입법 없이 기본적인 우려를 해결하기 위한 성실한 노력의 증거로 지적했다.

segments.src: ## The Core Tension: Definitions as Policy
segments.tr: ## 핵심 갈등: 정의를 정책으로

segments.src: Legal analysts who study technology regulation note that this dynamic is not unique to AI chatbots.
segments.tr: 기술 규제를 연구하는 법률 분석가들은 이러한 역학 관계가 AI 챗봇에만 국한되지 않는다고 지적한다.

segments.src: In sectors from social media to data privacy, definitional language has long been a primary battleground precisely because it is less visible to the public than headline mandates.
segments.tr: 소셜 미디어에서 데이터 개인정보 보호에 이르기까지 다양한 분야에서, 정의적 언어는 핵심 명령보다 대중에게 덜 눈에 띄기 때문에 오랫동안 주요 전투 지역이었다.

segments.src: A bill that bans "harmful design features targeting minors" reads very differently depending on how "companion chatbot" or "AI system" is legally defined — and those definitions are frequently drafted with direct input from the companies whose products will be judged against them.
segments.tr: 미성년자를 겨냥한 "해로운 설계 특징"을 금지하는 법안은 "반려자 챗봇" 또는 "AI 시스템"이 법적으로 어떻게 정의되는지에 따라 매우 다르게 읽힐 수 있으며, 이러한 정의는 그들의 제품이 이에 대해 판단받을 회사들의 직접적인 의견으로 자주 작성된다.

segments.src: Child safety advocates argue that this makes independent, expert-led drafting essential, and several groups have called for state attorneys general or dedicated technical advisory bodies — rather than industry lobbyists — to have the final say on scope-defining language.
segments.tr: 아동 안전 옹호자들은 이것이 독립적이고 전문가 주도의 초안을 필수적이라고 주장하며, 여러 그룹들은 산업 로비스트가 아닌 주 검찰총장이나 전담 기술 자문 기구가 범위를 정의하는 언어에 최종 발언권을 가져야 한다고 요청했다.

segments.src: Some legislators have echoed that call, while others maintain that collaboration with industry, conducted transparently and subject to public comment, remains a normal and necessary part of writing workable tech policy.
segments.tr: 일부 의원들은 그 요청에 동조했으며, 다른 의원들은 투명하게 실시되고 공개 의견에 따르는 산업과의 협력이 작동 가능한 기술 정책 작성의 정상적이고 필수적인 부분으로 남아 있다고 주장한다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 다음은

segments.src: None of the state bills reviewed have been shown to eliminate accountability outright, and several include provisions — such as private rights of action or mandatory incident reporting — that would apply broadly regardless of how narrowly a product is defined.
segments.tr: 검토된 주 법안 중 어느 것도 책임을 완전히 제거한 것으로 나타나지 않았으며, 여러 법안에는 개인의 조치 권리나 필수 사건 보고와 같은 조항이 포함되어 있어 제품이 얼마나 좁게 정의되는지에 관계없이 광범위하게 적용된다.

segments.src: Litigation stemming from the teen death cases is also proceeding separately from the legislative process and could shape industry practices regardless of what state law ultimately requires.
segments.tr: 청소년 사망 사건에서 비롯된 소송도 입법 과정과 별개로 진행 중이며 주 법이 궁극적으로 요구하는 것에 관계없이 산업 관행을 형성할 수 있다.

segments.src: For now, the story emerging from statehouses is less about whether AI chatbots will be regulated — nearly every stakeholder, including the companies themselves, now says some rules are inevitable — and more about who gets to write the fine print that decides how far those rules actually reach.
segments.tr: 현재로서는, 주 의사당에서 나오는 이야기는 AI 챗봇이 규제될 것인지 여부가 아니라 — 회사 자신을 포함한 거의 모든 이해관계자가 이제 일부 규칙이 불가피하다고 말한다 — 그 규칙이 실제로 얼마나 멀리 도달하는지를 결정하는 세부사항을 작성할 수 있는 사람에 관한 것이다.

segments.src: As more states finalize their bills in the coming months, the exemption language negotiated behind the scenes may end up mattering as much as the headlines announcing new protections for young users.
segments.tr: 앞으로 몇 개월 동안 더 많은 주가 그들의 법안을 최종 확정함에 따라, 무대 뒤에서 협상한 면제 언어는 청소년을 위한 새로운 보호를 발표하는 헤드라인만큼 중요할 수 있다.

segments.src: *This article is based on publicly reported legislative activity and statements from industry and advocacy groups.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 공개적으로 보도된 입법 활동과 산업 및 옹호 단체의 진술을 기반으로 한다.

segments.src: Details of pending litigation reflect allegations that have not been proven in court.*
segments.tr: 계류 중인 소송의 세부 사항은 법원에서 증명되지 않은 주장을 반영한다.*

zh.title: 州议会内部剧本：科技产业游说者如何塑造美国新的AI聊天机器人法律

segments.src: ## A Wave of State Action Follows Tragedy
segments.tr: ## 悲剧之后的州行动浪潮

segments.src: Over the past year, state legislatures across the country have moved with unusual speed to regulate AI chatbots, particularly those marketed as companions or emotional-support tools for young users.
segments.tr: 在过去的一年中，全国各地的州立法机构以异常的速度采取行动监管AI聊天机器人，特别是那些作为年轻用户的伴侣或情感支持工具进行推广的聊天机器人。

segments.src: The push follows a string of deeply troubling cases in which families have alleged that chatbot interactions played a role in a teenager's death by suicide.
segments.tr: 这一行动随之而来的是一系列令人深感不安的案件，在这些案件中，家族声称聊天机器人互动在一名青少年自杀身亡中起了作用。

segments.src: Those cases, several of which are now the subject of civil lawsuits, have turned what was once a niche policy conversation among AI researchers into a mainstream legislative priority.
segments.tr: 这些案件中的几起现在是民事诉讼的对象，它们将曾经是AI研究人员之间的利基政策讨论转变为主流的立法优先事项。

segments.src: By recent counts, roughly 15 states have introduced or advanced legislation aimed at chatbot safety — measures that range from mandatory crisis-referral protocols and age-verification requirements to disclosure rules requiring bots to clearly identify themselves as non-human.
segments.tr: 根据最近的统计，大约15个州已推出或推进了旨在聊天机器人安全的立法——这些措施范围从强制性危机转诊协议和年龄验证要求到披露规则，要求机器人明确自我识别为非人类。

segments.src: Lawmakers in both parties have described the effort as an urgent, bipartisan response to a technology that is evolving faster than the legal system meant to oversee it.
segments.tr: 两党的立法者都将这一努力描述为对一项技术的紧急、两党合作的回应，该技术的发展速度超过了旨在监督它的法律制度。

segments.src: ## Where Industry Involvement Comes In
segments.tr: ## 行业参与之处

segments.src: What has drawn fresh scrutiny is not the existence of these bills, but how some of them are being written.
segments.tr: 引起新审视的不是这些法案的存在，而是其中一些是如何被撰写的。

segments.src: Journalists and policy researchers who have reviewed lobbying disclosures and draft legislative language in several states report that major technology companies — including Google and other large AI developers — have been actively engaged in shaping the bills, not just opposing them outright.
segments.tr: 记者和政策研究人员审查了几个州的游说披露和立法草案语言，报告称主要科技公司——包括谷歌和其他大型AI开发者——一直积极参与塑造这些法案，而不仅仅是直接反对。

segments.src: According to this reporting, the industry's approach has often centered less on blocking regulation altogether and more on negotiating the fine print: definitions of what counts as a "companion chatbot," carve-outs for general-purpose assistants, and exemption clauses that determine which products actually fall under a given law's scope.
segments.tr: 根据这一报道，该行业的方法通常不是完全阻止监管，而更多是就细则进行协商：关于什么算作"伴侣聊天机器人"的定义、通用助手的豁免，以及决定哪些产品实际上属于特定法律范围的豁免条款。

segments.src: Critics argue that this kind of technical drafting can be just as consequential as a bill's headline provisions, since narrow or ambiguous definitions can leave the most widely used consumer AI products largely untouched even as smaller, less-resourced companion-app makers face the full weight of new compliance rules.
segments.tr: 批评者辩称，这种技术性草拟可能与法案的主要条款一样重要，因为狭隘或模糊的定义可能会使最广泛使用的消费者AI产品基本上不受影响，即使较小的、资源较少的伴侣应用开发者面临新合规规则的全部重担。

segments.src: Industry representatives have pushed back on characterizations that suggest improper influence.
segments.tr: 行业代表已对暗示不当影响的描述进行了反驳。

segments.src: Trade groups representing major tech firms have said their involvement in the legislative process is standard practice for any regulated industry, and that technical input from companies with deep engineering expertise helps lawmakers avoid writing rules that are unworkable, vague, or that inadvertently sweep in unrelated software like customer-service bots, search features, or productivity tools.
segments.tr: 代表主要科技公司的贸易组织表示，他们在立法过程中的参与是任何受管制行业的标准做法，来自具有深厚工程专业知识的公司的技术投入帮助立法者避免制定不可行、模糊或无意中包含无关软件（如客户服务机器人、搜索功能或生产力工具）的规则。

segments.src: Several companies have publicly stated they support "reasonable safeguards" for minors and have pointed to product changes — such as updated crisis-response prompts and parental controls — as evidence of good-faith efforts to address the underlying concerns independent of legislation.
segments.tr: 几家公司已公开表示支持对未成年人的"合理保护措施"，并指出产品更改——如更新的危机反应提示和家长控制——作为独立于立法之外、真诚努力解决根本关切的证据。

segments.src: ## The Core Tension: Definitions as Policy
segments.tr: ## 核心紧张关系：定义即政策

segments.src: Legal analysts who study technology regulation note that this dynamic is not unique to AI chatbots.
segments.tr: 研究技术监管的法律分析人士指出，这种动态对AI聊天机器人来说并不是独特的。

segments.src: In sectors from social media to data privacy, definitional language has long been a primary battleground precisely because it is less visible to the public than headline mandates.
segments.tr: 在从社交媒体到数据隐私的各个行业，定义性语言长期以来一直是主要的战场，正是因为它对公众的可见性低于主要强制规定。

segments.src: A bill that bans "harmful design features targeting minors" reads very differently depending on how "companion chatbot" or "AI system" is legally defined — and those definitions are frequently drafted with direct input from the companies whose products will be judged against them.
segments.tr: 一项禁止"针对未成年人的有害设计功能"的法案，读起来会非常不同，取决于"伴侣聊天机器人"或"AI系统"如何在法律上定义——而这些定义经常是在其产品将根据这些定义进行评判的公司的直接投入下草拟的。

segments.src: Child safety advocates argue that this makes independent, expert-led drafting essential, and several groups have called for state attorneys general or dedicated technical advisory bodies — rather than industry lobbyists — to have the final say on scope-defining language.
segments.tr: 儿童安全倡导者辩称，这使得独立、专家主导的草拟至关重要，几个组织已呼吁州检察长或专门的技术咨询机构——而不是行业游说者——对范围定义语言拥有最终发言权。

segments.src: Some legislators have echoed that call, while others maintain that collaboration with industry, conducted transparently and subject to public comment, remains a normal and necessary part of writing workable tech policy.
segments.tr: 一些立法者呼应了这一呼吁，而其他人则坚持认为与行业的合作，透明地进行并受制于公众评论，仍然是制定可行的技术政策的正常和必要的一部分。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来是什么

segments.src: None of the state bills reviewed have been shown to eliminate accountability outright, and several include provisions — such as private rights of action or mandatory incident reporting — that would apply broadly regardless of how narrowly a product is defined.
segments.tr: 所审查的州法案中没有一项已被证明会完全消除问责制，几项还包括条款——如私人诉讼权或强制事件报告——这些条款将广泛适用，无论产品的定义有多狭隘。

segments.src: Litigation stemming from the teen death cases is also proceeding separately from the legislative process and could shape industry practices regardless of what state law ultimately requires.
segments.tr: 源于青少年死亡案件的诉讼也独立于立法过程进行，无论州法最终要求什么，都可能塑造行业实践。

segments.src: For now, the story emerging from statehouses is less about whether AI chatbots will be regulated — nearly every stakeholder, including the companies themselves, now says some rules are inevitable — and more about who gets to write the fine print that decides how far those rules actually reach.
segments.tr: 目前，从州议会出现的故事不是关于AI聊天机器人是否会被监管——几乎每个利益相关者，包括公司本身，现在都说一些规则是不可避免的——而更多是关于谁能撰写决定这些规则实际能到达多远的细则。

segments.src: As more states finalize their bills in the coming months, the exemption language negotiated behind the scenes may end up mattering as much as the headlines announcing new protections for young users.

hi.title: स्टेटहाउस प्लेबुक के अंदर: तकनीकी उद्योग लॉबिस्ट अमेरिका के नए AI चैटबॉट कानूनों को कैसे आकार दे रहे हैं

segments.src: ## A Wave of State Action Follows Tragedy
segments.tr: ## राज्यों की कार्रवाई की एक लहर त्रासदी के बाद आती है

segments.src: Over the past year, state legislatures across the country have moved with unusual speed to regulate AI chatbots, particularly those marketed as companions or emotional-support tools for young users.
segments.tr: पिछले वर्ष में, पूरे देश में राज्य विधायिकाएं AI चैटबॉट को नियंत्रित करने के लिए असामान्य गति से काम कर रही हैं, विशेष रूप से जो साथियों या युवा उपयोगकर्ताओं के लिए भावनात्मक सहायता उपकरण के रूप में विपणन किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: The push follows a string of deeply troubling cases in which families have alleged that chatbot interactions played a role in a teenager's death by suicide.
segments.tr: यह प्रयास गहरे चिंताजनक मामलों की एक श्रृंखला के बाद आता है जिसमें परिवारों ने आरोप लगाया है कि चैटबॉट इंटरैक्शन एक किशोर की आत्महत्या से मृत्यु में भूमिका निभाते हैं।

segments.src: Those cases, several of which are now the subject of civil lawsuits, have turned what was once a niche policy conversation among AI researchers into a mainstream legislative priority.
segments.tr: वे मामले, जिनमें से कई अब नागरिक मुकदमों का विषय हैं, ने जो कभी AI शोधकर्ताओं के बीच एक विशेष नीति बातचीत थी, को एक मुख्यधारा विधायी प्राथमिकता में बदल दिया है।

segments.src: By recent counts, roughly 15 states have introduced or advanced legislation aimed at chatbot safety — measures that range from mandatory crisis-referral protocols and age-verification requirements to disclosure rules requiring bots to clearly identify themselves as non-human.
segments.tr: हाल की गिनती के अनुसार, लगभग 15 राज्यों ने चैटबॉट सुरक्षा के लिए लक्षित कानून पेश किए या आगे बढ़ाए हैं — उपाय जो अनिवार्य संकट-संदर्भ प्रोटोकॉल और आयु-सत्यापन आवश्यकताओं से लेकर प्रकटीकरण नियमों तक हैं जो बॉट को स्पष्ट रूप से गैर-मानव के रूप में पहचान करने की आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: Lawmakers in both parties have described the effort as an urgent, bipartisan response to a technology that is evolving faster than the legal system meant to oversee it.
segments.tr: दोनों पक्षों के सांसदों ने इस प्रयास को एक तकनीक के लिए एक तत्काल, द्विपक्षीय प्रतिक्रिया के रूप में वर्णित किया है जो इसकी निगरानी के लिए अभिप्रेत कानूनी प्रणाली से अधिक तेजी से विकसित हो रहा है।

segments.src: ## Where Industry Involvement Comes In
segments.tr: ## उद्योग की भागीदारी कहाँ आती है

segments.src: What has drawn fresh scrutiny is not the existence of these bills, but how some of them are being written.
segments.tr: जिसने ताजा जांच आकर्षित की है वह इन बिलों का अस्तित्व नहीं है, बल्कि उनमें से कुछ कैसे लिखे जा रहे हैं।

segments.src: Journalists and policy researchers who have reviewed lobbying disclosures and draft legislative language in several states report that major technology companies — including Google and other large AI developers — have been actively engaged in shaping the bills, not just opposing them outright.
segments.tr: पत्रकारों और नीति शोधकर्ताओं जिन्होंने कई राज्यों में लॉबिंग प्रकटीकरण और मसौदा विधायी भाषा की समीक्षा की है, बताते हैं कि प्रमुख तकनीकी कंपनियां — Google और अन्य बड़े AI डेवलपर्स सहित — बिलों को आकार देने में सक्रिय रूप से लगी हुई हैं, न कि केवल उन्हें पूरी तरह से विरोध कर रही हैं।

segments.src: According to this reporting, the industry's approach has often centered less on blocking regulation altogether and more on negotiating the fine print: definitions of what counts as a "companion chatbot," carve-outs for general-purpose assistants, and exemption clauses that determine which products actually fall under a given law's scope.
segments.tr: इस रिपोर्टिंग के अनुसार, उद्योग का दृष्टिकोण अक्सर नियमन को पूरी तरह से अवरुद्ध करने पर कम और छोटे प्रिंट पर बातचीत करने पर अधिक केंद्रित है: "साथी चैटबॉट" के रूप में क्या गिना जाता है, इसकी परिभाषा, सामान्य-उद्देश्य सहायकों के लिए कटौती, और छूट खंड जो यह निर्धारित करते हैं कि कौन से उत्पाद वास्तव में किसी दिए गए कानून के दायरे में आते हैं।

segments.src: Critics argue that this kind of technical drafting can be just as consequential as a bill's headline provisions, since narrow or ambiguous definitions can leave the most widely used consumer AI products largely untouched even as smaller, less-resourced companion-app makers face the full weight of new compliance rules.
segments.tr: आलोचकों का तर्क है कि इस प्रकार का तकनीकी मसौदा एक बिल के शीर्षक प्रावधानों जितना ही परिणामी हो सकता है, क्योंकि संकीर्ण या अस्पष्ट परिभाषाएं सबसे व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किए जाने वाले उपभोक्ता AI उत्पादों को बड़े पैमाने पर अछूता रख सकते हैं, भले ही छोटे, कम-संसाधित साथी-ऐप निर्माता नए अनुपालन नियमों का पूरा भार का सामना कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Industry representatives have pushed back on characterizations that suggest improper influence.
segments.tr: उद्योग के प्रतिनिधियों ने ऐसे विशेषताओं पर जवाबी कार्रवाई की है जो अनुचित प्रभाव का सुझाव देते हैं।

segments.src: Trade groups representing major tech firms have said their involvement in the legislative process is standard practice for any regulated industry, and that technical input from companies with deep engineering expertise helps lawmakers avoid writing rules that are unworkable, vague, or that inadvertently sweep in unrelated software like customer-service bots, search features, or productivity tools.
segments.tr: प्रमुख तकनीकी फर्मों का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले व्यापार समूहों ने कहा है कि विधायी प्रक्रिया में उनकी भागीदारी किसी भी नियंत्रित उद्योग के लिए मानक अभ्यास है, और गहरी इंजीनियरिंग विशेषज्ञता वाली कंपनियों से तकनीकी इनपुट सांसदों को ऐसे नियम लिखने से बचने में मदद करता है जो अव्यावहारिक, अस्पष्ट हैं, या जो अनजाने में ग्राहक-सेवा बॉट, खोज सुविधाओं, या उत्पादकता उपकरणों जैसे असंबंधित सॉफ़्टवेयर को शामिल करते हैं।

segments.src: Several companies have publicly stated they support "reasonable safeguards" for minors and have pointed to product changes — such as updated crisis-response prompts and parental controls — as evidence of good-faith efforts to address the underlying concerns independent of legislation.
segments.tr: कई कंपनियों ने सार्वजनिक रूप से कहा है कि वे नाबालिगों के लिए "उचित सुरक्षा" का समर्थन करते हैं और उत्पाद परिवर्तनों की ओर इशारा किया है — जैसे कि अपडेट किए गए संकट-प्रतिक्रिया प्रोम्प्ट और पैतृक नियंत्रण — विधायन से स्वतंत्र अंतर्निहित चिंताओं को संबोधित करने के लिए सद्भावना प्रयासों के प्रमाण के रूप में।

segments.src: ## The Core Tension: Definitions as Policy
segments.tr: ## मुख्य तनाव: परिभाषाएँ नीति के रूप में

segments.src: Legal analysts who study technology regulation note that this dynamic is not unique to AI chatbots.
segments.tr: कानूनी विश्लेषकों जो प्रौद्योगिकी नियमन का अध्ययन करते हैं, ध्यान दें कि यह गतिशीलता AI चैटबॉट के लिए अद्वितीय नहीं है।

segments.src: In sectors from social media to data privacy, definitional language has long been a primary battleground precisely because it is less visible to the public than headline mandates.
segments.tr: सोशल मीडिया से लेकर डेटा गोपनीयता तक के क्षेत्रों में, परिभाषात्मक भाषा लंबे समय से एक प्राथमिक युद्ध क्षेत्र रहा है, क्योंकि यह शीर्षक जनादेशों की तुलना में जनता के लिए कम दृश्यमान है।

segments.src: A bill that bans "harmful design features targeting minors" reads very differently depending on how "companion chatbot" or "AI system" is legally defined — and those definitions are frequently drafted with direct input from the companies whose products will be judged against them.
segments.tr: एक बिल जो "नाबालिगों को लक्षित करने वाली हानिकारक डिजाइन सुविधाओं" पर प्रतिबंध लगाता है, बहुत अलग तरीके से पढ़ता है, यह इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि "साथी चैटबॉट" या "AI सिस्टम" को कानूनी रूप से कैसे परिभाषित किया गया है — और वे परिभाषाएं अक्सर उन कंपनियों से सीधे इनपुट के साथ तैयार की जाती हैं, जिनके उत्पादों का उनके विरुद्ध न्याय किया जाएगा।

segments.src: Child safety advocates argue that this makes independent, expert-led drafting essential, and several groups have called for state attorneys general or dedicated technical advisory bodies — rather than industry lobbyists — to have the final say on scope-defining language.
segments.tr: बाल सुरक्षा वकीलों का तर्क है कि यह स्वतंत्र, विशेषज्ञ-नेतृत्व वाली मसौदा आवश्यक बनाता है, और कई समूहों ने राज्य अटॉर्नी जनरल या समर्पित तकनीकी सलाहकार निकायों के लिए आह्वान किया है — उद्योग लॉबिस्ट के बजाय — दायरा-परिभाषित भाषा पर अंतिम कहना है।

segments.src: Some legislators have echoed that call, while others maintain that collaboration with industry, conducted transparently and subject to public comment, remains a normal and necessary part of writing workable tech policy.
segments.tr: कुछ सांसदों ने उस आह्वान को प्रतिध्वनित किया है, जबकि अन्य दावा करते हैं कि उद्योग के साथ सहयोग, पारदर्शी रूप से संचालित और सार्वजनिक टिप्पणी के अधीन, कार्यशील तकनीकी नीति लिखने का एक सामान्य और आवश्यक हिस्सा बना हुआ है।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## इसके बाद क्या आता है

segments.src: None of the state bills reviewed have been shown to eliminate accountability outright, and several include provisions — such as private rights of action or mandatory incident reporting — that would apply broadly regardless of how narrowly a product is defined.
segments.tr: समीक्षा किए गए किसी भी राज्य बिल को जवाबदेही को पूरी तरह से समाप्त करने के लिए नहीं दिखाया गया है, और कई में प्रावधान शामिल हैं — जैसे कि कार्रवाई के निजी अधिकार या अनिवार्य घटना रिपोर्टिंग — जो व्यापक रूप से लागू होंगे, चाहे कोई उत्पाद कितनी संकीर्णता से परिभाषित हो।

segments.src: Litigation stemming from the teen death cases is also proceeding separately from the legislative process and could shape industry practices regardless of what state law ultimately requires.
segments.tr: किशोर मृत्यु के मामलों से उत्पन्न मुकदमेबाजी विधायी प्रक्रिया से अलग से भी चल रही है और उद्योग प्रथाओं को आकार दे सकती है, चाहे राज्य कानून अंततः क्या आवश्यकता है।

segments.src: For now, the story emerging from statehouses is less about whether AI chatbots will be regulated — nearly every stakeholder, including the companies themselves, now says some rules are inevitable — and more about who gets to write the fine print that decides how far those rules actually reach.
segments.tr: अब के लिए, राजभवन से उभरने वाली कहानी इस बारे में कम है कि क्या AI चैटबॉट को नियंत्रित किया जाएगा — लगभग हर हितधारक, कंपनियों सहित, अब कहते हैं कि कुछ नियम अपरिहार्य हैं — और अधिक इस बारे में कि कौन छोटे प्रिंट लिखने के लिए प्राप्त करता है जो यह तय करता है कि वे नियम वास्तव में कितनी दूर तक पहुंचते हैं।

segments.src: As more states finalize their bills in the coming months, the exemption language negotiated behind the scenes may end up mattering as much as the headlines announcing new protections for young users.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे अधिक राज्य आने वाले महीनों में अपने बिलों को अंतिम रूप देते हैं, पर्दे के पीछे बातचीत की गई छूट भाषा युवा उपयोगकर्ताओं के लिए नए सुरक्षा की घोषणा करने वाली हेडलाइनों जितनी ही महत्वपूर्ण हो सकती है।

segments.tr: *यह लेख सार्वजनिक रूप से रिपोर्ट की गई विधायी गतिविधि और उद्योग और वकालत समूहों के बयानों पर आधारित है।

segments.tr: लंबित मुकदमेबाजी के विवरण ऐसे आरोपों को दर्शाते हैं जो अदालत में साबित नहीं हुए हैं।*

segments.tr: Según este informe, el enfoque de la industria a menudo se ha centrado menos en bloquear completamente la regulación y más en negociar los detalles: definiciones de lo que cuenta como un "chatbot de compañía", excepciones para asistentes de propósito general, y cláusulas de exención que determinan qué productos realmente caen bajo el alcance de una ley determinada.

segments.src: Critics argue that this kind of technical drafting can be just as consequential as a bill's headline provisions, since narrow or ambiguous definitions can leave the most widely used consumer AI products largely untouched even as smaller, less-resourced companion-app makers face the full weight of new compliance rules.
segments.tr: Los críticos argumentan que este tipo de redacción técnica puede ser tan consecuente como las disposiciones principales de un proyecto de ley, ya que las definiciones estrechas o ambiguas pueden dejar los productos de IA de consumo más ampliamente utilizados en gran medida intactos, incluso cuando los fabricantes de aplicaciones de compañía más pequeños y menos financiados enfrentan todo el peso de las nuevas reglas de cumplimiento.

segments.src: Industry representatives have pushed back on characterizations that suggest improper influence.
segments.tr: Los representantes de la industria han rechazado las caracterizaciones que sugieren influencia indebida.

segments.src: Trade groups representing major tech firms have said their involvement in the legislative process is standard practice for any regulated industry, and that technical input from companies with deep engineering expertise helps lawmakers avoid writing rules that are unworkable, vague, or that inadvertently sweep in unrelated software like customer-service bots, search features, or productivity tools.
segments.tr: Los grupos comerciales que representan a las principales empresas tecnológicas han dicho que su participación en el proceso legislativo es una práctica estándar para cualquier industria regulada, y que la aportación técnica de empresas con profunda experiencia en ingeniería ayuda a los legisladores a evitar escribir reglas que sean inviables, vagas, o que barran inadvertidamente software no relacionado como bots de servicio al cliente, características de búsqueda, o herramientas de productividad.

segments.src: Several companies have publicly stated they support "reasonable safeguards" for minors and have pointed to product changes — such as updated crisis-response prompts and parental controls — as evidence of good-faith efforts to address the underlying concerns independent of legislation.
segments.tr: Varias empresas han declarado públicamente que apoyan "salvaguardas razonables" para menores y han señalado cambios de producto — como indicaciones de respuesta a crisis actualizadas y controles parentales — como evidencia de esfuerzos de buena fe para abordar las preocupaciones subyacentes independientemente de la legislación.

segments.src: ## The Core Tension: Definitions as Policy
segments.tr: ## La Tensión Central: Definiciones como Política

segments.src: Legal analysts who study technology regulation note that this dynamic is not unique to AI chatbots.
segments.tr: Los analistas legales que estudian la regulación tecnológica señalan que esta dinámica no es única para los chatbots de IA.

segments.src: In sectors from social media to data privacy, definitional language has long been a primary battleground precisely because it is less visible to the public than headline mandates.
segments.tr: En sectores desde las redes sociales hasta la privacidad de datos, el lenguaje definitorio ha sido durante mucho tiempo un campo de batalla principal precisamente porque es menos visible para el público que los mandatos titulares.

segments.src: A bill that bans "harmful design features targeting minors" reads very differently depending on how "companion chatbot" or "AI system" is legally defined — and those definitions are frequently drafted with direct input from the companies whose products will be judged against them.
segments.tr: Un proyecto de ley que prohíbe las "características de diseño perjudiciales dirigidas a menores" se lee muy diferente dependiendo de cómo se defina legalmente "chatbot de compañía" o "sistema de IA" — y esas definiciones frecuentemente se redactan con aporte directo de las empresas cuyos productos serán juzgados contra ellos.

segments.src: Child safety advocates argue that this makes independent, expert-led drafting essential, and several groups have called for state attorneys general or dedicated technical advisory bodies — rather than industry lobbyists — to have the final say on scope-defining language.
segments.tr: Los defensores de la seguridad infantil argumentan que esto hace que la redacción independiente y dirigida por expertos sea esencial, y varios grupos han pedido que los fiscales generales estatales o cuerpos de asesoramiento técnico dedicados — en lugar de cabilderos de la industria — tengan la última palabra en el lenguaje que define el alcance.

segments.src: Some legislators have echoed that call, while others maintain that collaboration with industry, conducted transparently and subject to public comment, remains a normal and necessary part of writing workable tech policy.
segments.tr: Algunos legisladores han hecho eco de ese llamado, mientras que otros sostienen que la colaboración con la industria, realizada de forma transparente y sujeta a comentarios públicos, sigue siendo una parte normal y necesaria de la redacción de políticas tecnológicas viables.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next

segments.src: Litigation stemming from the teen death cases is also proceeding separately from the legislative process and could shape industry practices regardless of what state law ultimately requires.
segments.tr: El litigio derivado de los casos de muerte de adolescentes también está procediendo por separado del proceso legislativo y podría moldear las prácticas de la industria independientemente de lo que finalmente requiera la ley estatal.

segments.src: For now, the story emerging from statehouses is less about whether AI chatbots will be regulated — nearly every stakeholder, including the companies themselves, now says some rules are inevitable — and more about who gets to write the fine print that decides how far those rules actually reach.

segments.src: The push follows a string of deeply troubling cases in which families have alleged that chatbot interactions played a role in a teenager's death by suicide.
segments.tr: يأتي هذا الدفع بعد سلسلة من الحالات المقلقة للغاية التي زعمت فيها عائلات أن تفاعلات برامج الدردشة الآلية لعبت دوراً في وفاة مراهق بالانتحار.

segments.src: Those cases, several of which are now the subject of civil lawsuits, have turned what was once a niche policy conversation among AI researchers into a mainstream legislative priority.

segments.tr: Les groupes commerciaux représentant les grandes entreprises technologiques ont déclaré que leur participation au processus législatif est une pratique courante pour toute industrie réglementée, et que les contributions techniques des entreprises possédant une expertise technique approfondie aident les législateurs à éviter de rédiger des règles qui sont impraticables, vagues, ou qui entraînent involontairement des logiciels non liés comme les chatbots de service clientèle, les fonctionnalités de recherche, ou les outils de productivité.

segments.src: Several companies have publicly stated they support "reasonable safeguards" for minors and have pointed to product changes — such as updated crisis-response prompts and parental controls — as evidence of good-faith efforts to address the underlying concerns independent of legislation.
segments.tr: Plusieurs entreprises ont déclaré publiquement qu'elles soutiennent les « mesures de protection raisonnables » pour les mineurs et ont indiqué les changements de produits — tels que les invites de réponse aux crises mises à jour et les contrôles parentaux — comme preuve d'efforts de bonne foi pour résoudre les préoccupations sous-jacentes indépendamment de la législation.

segments.src: ## The Core Tension: Definitions as Policy
segments.tr: ## La tension centrale : les définitions comme politique

segments.src: Legal analysts who study technology regulation note that this dynamic is not unique to AI chatbots.
segments.tr: Les analystes juridiques qui étudient la réglementation technologique notent que cette dynamique n'est pas unique aux chatbots IA.

segments.src: In sectors from social media to data privacy, definitional language has long been a primary battleground precisely because it is less visible to the public than headline mandates.
segments.tr: Dans les secteurs des médias sociaux à la confidentialité des données, le langage de définition a longtemps été un enjeu principal précisément parce qu'il est moins visible au public que les mandats de titre.

segments.src: A bill that bans "harmful design features targeting minors" reads very differently depending on how "companion chatbot" or "AI system" is legally defined — and those definitions are frequently drafted with direct input from the companies whose products will be judged against them.
segments.tr: Un projet de loi qui interdit les « caractéristiques de conception nuisibles ciblant les mineurs » se lit très différemment selon la façon dont « chatbot compagnon » ou « système d'IA » est légalement défini — et ces définitions sont souvent rédigées avec l'apport direct des entreprises dont les produits seront jugés par rapport à elles.

segments.src: Child safety advocates argue that this makes independent, expert-led drafting essential, and several groups have called for state attorneys general or dedicated technical advisory bodies — rather than industry lobbyists — to have the final say on scope-defining language.
segments.tr: Les défenseurs de la sécurité des enfants soutiennent que cela rend la rédaction indépendante et dirigée par des experts essentielle, et plusieurs groupes ont demandé que les procureurs généraux des États ou les organismes consultatifs techniques dédiés — plutôt que les lobbyistes de l'industrie — aient le dernier mot sur le langage définissant la portée.

segments.src: Some legislators have echoed that call, while others maintain that collaboration with industry, conducted transparently and subject to public comment, remains a normal and necessary part of writing workable tech policy.
segments.tr: Certains législateurs ont fait écho à cet appel, tandis que d'autres maintiennent que la collaboration avec l'industrie, menée de manière transparente et soumise aux commentaires du public, reste une partie normale et nécessaire de la rédaction d'une politique technologique viable.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Que se passe-t-il ensuite

segments.src: None of the state bills reviewed have been shown to eliminate accountability outright, and several include provisions — such as private rights of action or mandatory incident reporting — that would apply broadly regardless of how narrowly a product is defined.
segments.tr: Aucun des projets de loi d'État examinés n'a été montré pour éliminer la responsabilité purement et simplement, et plusieurs incluent des dispositions — telles que les droits d'action privés ou les rapports d'incidents obligatoires — qui s'appliqueraient largement indépendamment de la façon dont un produit est défini étroitement.

segments.src: Litigation stemming from the teen death cases is also proceeding separately from the legislative process and could shape industry practices regardless of what state law ultimately requires.
segments.tr: Les litiges découlant des cas de mort d'adolescents sont également en cours séparément du processus législatif et pourraient façonner les pratiques de l'industrie indépendamment de ce que la loi d'État exige finalement.

segments.src: For now, the story emerging from statehouses is less about whether AI chatbots will be regulated — nearly every stakeholder, including the companies themselves, now says some rules are inevitable — and more about who gets to write the fine print that decides how far those rules actually reach.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, l'histoire qui émerge des capitales d'État concerne moins la question de savoir si les chatbots IA seront régulementés — presque toutes les parties prenantes, y compris les entreprises elles-mêmes, disent maintenant que certaines règles sont inévitables — et davantage sur qui aura le droit de rédiger les petits caractères qui décident de la portée réelle de ces règles.

segments.src: As more states finalize their bills in the coming months, the exemption language negotiated behind the scenes may end up mattering as much as the headlines announcing new protections for young users.
segments.tr: Alors que d'autres États finalisent leurs projets de loi dans les mois à venir, le langage d'exemption négocié en coulisse pourrait s'avérer aussi important que les titres annonçant de nouvelles protections pour les jeunes utilisateurs.

pt.title: Dentro do Manual Legislativo: Como Lobistas da Indústria de Tecnologia Estão Moldando as Novas Leis de Chatbots de IA Americanas

segments.src: ## A Wave of State Action Follows Tragedy
segments.tr: ## Uma Onda de Ações Estaduais Segue a Tragédia

segments.src: Over the past year, state legislatures across the country have moved with unusual speed to regulate AI chatbots, particularly those marketed as companions or emotional-support tools for young users.
segments.tr: Nos últimos doze meses, legislaturas estaduais em todo o país se moveram com velocidade incomum para regular chatbots de IA, particularmente aqueles comercializados como companheiros ou ferramentas de suporte emocional para usuários jovens.

segments.src: The push follows a string of deeply troubling cases in which families have alleged that chatbot interactions played a role in a teenager's death by suicide.
segments.tr: Esse movimento segue uma série de casos profundamente perturbadores nos quais famílias alegaram que as interações com chatbots desempenharam um papel na morte de um adolescente por suicídio.

segments.src: Those cases, several of which are now the subject of civil lawsuits, have turned what was once a niche policy conversation among AI researchers into a mainstream legislative priority.
segments.tr: Esses casos, vários dos quais agora são objeto de ações civis, transformaram o que era antes uma conversa política de nicho entre pesquisadores de IA em uma prioridade legislativa convencional.

segments.src: By recent counts, roughly 15 states have introduced or advanced legislation aimed at chatbot safety — measures that range from mandatory crisis-referral protocols and age-verification requirements to disclosure rules requiring bots to clearly identify themselves as non-human.
segments.tr: Segundo contagens recentes, aproximadamente 15 estados introduziram ou avançaram legislação destinada à segurança do chatbot — medidas que variam desde protocolos obrigatórios de encaminhamento de crises e requisitos de verificação de idade até regras de divulgação que exigem que os bots se identifiquem claramente como não-humanos.

segments.src: Lawmakers in both parties have described the effort as an urgent, bipartisan response to a technology that is evolving faster than the legal system meant to oversee it.
segments.tr: Legisladores de ambos os partidos descreveram o esforço como uma resposta urgente e bipartidária a uma tecnologia que está evoluindo mais rápido do que o sistema legal responsável por supervisioná-la.

segments.src: ## Where Industry Involvement Comes In
segments.tr: ## Onde Entra o Envolvimento da Indústria

segments.src: What has drawn fresh scrutiny is not the existence of these bills, but how some of them are being written.
segments.tr: O que atraiu novo escrutínio não é a existência desses projetos de lei, mas como alguns deles estão sendo redigidos.

segments.src: Journalists and policy researchers who have reviewed lobbying disclosures and draft legislative language in several states report that major technology companies — including Google and other large AI developers — have been actively engaged in shaping the bills, not just opposing them outright.
segments.tr: Jornalistas e pesquisadores de políticas que revisaram divulgações de lobby e linguagem legislativa em rascunho em vários estados relatam que as principais empresas de tecnologia — incluindo Google e outros grandes desenvolvedores de IA — foram ativamente envolvidas na modelagem dos projetos de lei, não apenas se opondo a eles completamente.

segments.src: According to this reporting, the industry's approach has often centered less on blocking regulation altogether and more on negotiating the fine print: definitions of what counts as a "companion chatbot," carve-outs for general-purpose assistants, and exemption clauses that determine which products actually fall under a given law's scope.
segments.tr: De acordo com esse relatório, a abordagem da indústria frequentemente se centrou menos em bloquear a regulamentação completamente e mais em negociar os detalhes: definições do que é considerado um "chatbot companheiro," ressalvas para assistentes de propósito geral e cláusulas de isenção que determinam quais produtos realmente se enquadram no escopo de uma determinada lei.

segments.src: Critics argue that this kind of technical drafting can be just as consequential as a bill's headline provisions, since narrow or ambiguous definitions can leave the most widely used consumer AI products largely untouched even as smaller, less-resourced companion-app makers face the full weight of new compliance rules.
segments.tr: Críticos argumentam que esse tipo de redação técnica pode ser tão consequencial quanto as disposições principais de um projeto de lei, uma vez que definições estreitas ou ambíguas podem deixar os produtos de IA para consumidores mais amplamente utilizados em grande parte intocados, mesmo enquanto fabricantes menores de aplicativos companheiros, com menos recursos, enfrentam o peso total das novas regras de conformidade.

segments.src: Industry representatives have pushed back on characterizations that suggest improper influence.
segments.tr: Representantes da indústria reagiram contra caracterizações que sugerem influência imprópria.

segments.src: Trade groups representing major tech firms have said their involvement in the legislative process is standard practice for any regulated industry, and that technical input from companies with deep engineering expertise helps lawmakers avoid writing rules that are unworkable, vague, or that inadvertently sweep in unrelated software like customer-service bots, search features, or productivity tools.
segments.tr: Grupos comerciais que representam grandes empresas de tecnologia disseram que seu envolvimento no processo legislativo é prática padrão para qualquer indústria regulada, e que a entrada técnica de empresas com experiência profunda em engenharia ajuda os legisladores a evitar escrever regras que são impraticáveis, vagas ou que inadvertidamente incluem software não relacionado, como bots de atendimento ao cliente, recursos de pesquisa ou ferramentas de produtividade.

segments.src: Several companies have publicly stated they support "reasonable safeguards" for minors and have pointed to product changes — such as updated crisis-response prompts and parental controls — as evidence of good-faith efforts to address the underlying concerns independent of legislation.
segments.tr: Várias empresas declararam publicamente que apoiam "salvaguardas razoáveis" para menores e apontaram para mudanças de produtos — como prompts atualizados de resposta a crises e controles parentais — como evidência de esforços de boa-fé para abordar as preocupações subjacentes independentemente da legislação.

segments.src: ## The Core Tension: Definitions as Policy
segments.tr: ## A Tensão Central: Definições como Política

segments.tr: Analistas jurídicos que estudam a regulamentação de tecnologia observam que essa dinâmica não é exclusiva dos chatbots de IA.

segments.src: In sectors from social media to data privacy, definitional language has long been a primary battleground precisely because it is less visible to the public than headline mandates.
segments.tr: Em setores que variam de mídia social a privacidade de dados, a linguagem de definição há muito é um campo de batalha primário precisamente porque é menos visível ao público do que os mandatos de manchete.

segments.src: A bill that bans "harmful design features targeting minors" reads very differently depending on how "companion chatbot" or "AI system" is legally defined — and those definitions are frequently drafted with direct input from the companies whose products will be judged against them.
segments.tr: Um projeto de lei que proíbe "recursos de design prejudicial direcionados a menores" é lido muito diferentemente dependendo de como "chatbot companheiro" ou "sistema de IA" é legalmente definido — e essas definições são frequentemente redigidas com entrada direta das empresas cujos produtos serão julgados contra elas.

segments.src: Child safety advocates argue that this makes independent, expert-led drafting essential, and several groups have called for state attorneys general or dedicated technical advisory bodies — rather than industry lobbyists — to have the final say on scope-defining language.
segments.tr: Defensores da segurança infantil argumentam que isso torna a redação independente e liderada por especialistas essencial, e vários grupos pediram aos procuradores-gerais do estado ou órgãos consultivos técnicos dedicados — em vez de lobistas da indústria — para ter a última palavra sobre a linguagem que define o escopo.

segments.src: Some legislators have echoed that call, while others maintain that collaboration with industry, conducted transparently and subject to public comment, remains a normal and necessary part of writing workable tech policy.
segments.tr: Alguns legisladores ecoaram esse apelo, enquanto outros argumentam que a colaboração com a indústria, conduzida de forma transparente e sujeita a comentários públicos, permanece uma parte normal e necessária da redação de políticas de tecnologia viáveis.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Vem a Seguir

segments.src: None of the state bills reviewed have been shown to eliminate accountability outright, and several include provisions — such as private rights of action or mandatory incident reporting — that would apply broadly regardless of how narrowly a product is defined.
segments.tr: Nenhum dos projetos de lei estaduais revisados foi demonstrado como eliminando a responsabilidade completamente, e vários incluem disposições — como direitos privados de ação ou relatório obrigatório de incidentes — que se aplicariam amplamente independentemente de como um produto é definido de forma restrita.

segments.src: Litigation stemming from the teen death cases is also proceeding separately from the legislative process and could shape industry practices regardless of what state law ultimately requires.
segments.tr: O litígio decorrente dos casos de morte de adolescentes também está prosseguindo separadamente do processo legislativo e poderia moldar as práticas da indústria independentemente do que a lei estadual finalmente exigir.

segments.src: For now, the story emerging from statehouses is less about whether AI chatbots will be regulated — nearly every stakeholder, including the companies themselves, now says some rules are inevitable — and more about who gets to write the fine print that decides how far those rules actually reach.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, a história que emerge das casas legislativas é menos sobre se os chatbots de IA serão regulados — quase todas as partes interessadas, incluindo as próprias empresas, agora dizem que algumas regras são inevitáveis — e mais sobre quem consegue escrever os detalhes que decidem até que ponto essas regras realmente alcançam.

segments.src: As more states finalize their bills in the coming months, the exemption language negotiated behind the scenes may end up mattering as much as the headlines announcing new protections for young users.
segments.tr: À medida que mais estados finalizam seus projetos de lei nos próximos meses, a linguagem de isenção negociada nos bastidores pode acabar importando tanto quanto as manchetes anunciando novas proteções para usuários jovens.

segments.src: ## A Wave of State Action Follows Tragedy
segments.tr: ## 悲劇に続く州による行動の波

segments.src: Over the past year, state legislatures across the country have moved with unusual speed to regulate AI chatbots, particularly those marketed as companions or emotional-support tools for young users.
segments.tr: 過去1年間、全国の州議会は、特に若いユーザーを対象に相棒やメンタルサポートツールとして販売されているAIチャットボットを規制するために、異常なほどの速さで動いてきました。

segments.src: The push follows a string of deeply troubling cases in which families have alleged that chatbot interactions played a role in a teenager's death by suicide.
segments.tr: この動きは、チャットボットとのやり取りが十代の自殺に関与したと家族が主張している、一連の極めて懸念される事件に続いています。

segments.src: Those cases, several of which are now the subject of civil lawsuits, have turned what was once a niche policy conversation among AI researchers into a mainstream legislative priority.
segments.tr: これらの事件のいくつかが現在民事訴訟の対象となっており、かつてAI研究者間のニッチな政策議論だったものを、主流の立法上の優先事項へと変えました。

segments.src: By recent counts, roughly 15 states have introduced or advanced legislation aimed at chatbot safety — measures that range from mandatory crisis-referral protocols and age-verification requirements to disclosure rules requiring bots to clearly identify themselves as non-human.
segments.tr: 最近の集計では、約15の州がチャットボットの安全性を目的とした法律を導入または推進しており、強制的な危機対応プロトコルと年齢確認要件から、ボットが非人間であることを明確に識別するよう要求する開示ルールまでの範囲の措置です。

segments.src: Lawmakers in both parties have described the effort as an urgent, bipartisan response to a technology that is evolving faster than the legal system meant to oversee it.
segments.tr: 両党の議員は、この取り組みを、それを監督することを意図した法制度よりも速く進化している技術への緊急の超党派的対応として説明しています。

segments.src: ## Where Industry Involvement Comes In
segments.tr: ## 業界の関与がどこで登場するか

segments.src: What has drawn fresh scrutiny is not the existence of these bills, but how some of them are being written.
segments.tr: 新たな精査の焦点となったのは、これらの法案の存在ではなく、その一部がどのように作成されているかです。

segments.src: Journalists and policy researchers who have reviewed lobbying disclosures and draft legislative language in several states report that major technology companies — including Google and other large AI developers — have been actively engaged in shaping the bills, not just opposing them outright.
segments.tr: 複数の州のロビイング開示と立法案のドラフトを確認したジャーナリストと政策研究者は、Googleおよびその他の大規模なAI開発者を含む主要なテクノロジー企業が、単に法案に反対するだけでなく、法案の形成に積極的に関与してきたと報告しています。

segments.src: According to this reporting, the industry's approach has often centered less on blocking regulation altogether and more on negotiating the fine print: definitions of what counts as a "companion chatbot," carve-outs for general-purpose assistants, and exemption clauses that determine which products actually fall under a given law's scope.
segments.tr: このレポートによれば、業界のアプローチはしばしば規制を完全にブロックすることにではなく、細部の交渉に焦点が当てられています。具体的には、「コンパニオンチャットボット」の定義、汎用アシスタント用の除外規定、および特定の法律の範囲に実際に適用される製品を決定する免除条項です。

segments.src: Critics argue that this kind of technical drafting can be just as consequential as a bill's headline provisions, since narrow or ambiguous definitions can leave the most widely used consumer AI products largely untouched even as smaller, less-resourced companion-app makers face the full weight of new compliance rules.
segments.tr: 批評家は、この種の技術的な作成は法案の見出し条項と同じくらい重要である可能性があると主張しています。なぜなら、狭い定義または曖昧な定義は、最も広く使われているコンシューマーAI製品をほぼ手付かずのままにすることができる一方で、リソースの限定的な小規模なコンパニオンアプリメーカーは新しいコンプライアンス規則の全面的な重みに直面するからです。

segments.src: Industry representatives have pushed back on characterizations that suggest improper influence.
segments.tr: 業界代表者は、不適切な影響を示唆する描写に異議を唱えています。

segments.src: Trade groups representing major tech firms have said their involvement in the legislative process is standard practice for any regulated industry, and that technical input from companies with deep engineering expertise helps lawmakers avoid writing rules that are unworkable, vague, or that inadvertently sweep in unrelated software like customer-service bots, search features, or productivity tools.
segments.tr: 大手テク企業を代表する業界団体は、立法プロセスへの関与は規制産業にとって標準的な慣行であり、深いエンジニアリング専門知識を持つ企業からの技術的入力は、議員が実行不可能な、曖昧な、または顧客サービスボット、検索機能、生産性ツールなどの無関係なソフトウェアを不注意に含める可能性のあるルールを作成することを避けるのに役立つと述べています。

segments.src: Several companies have publicly stated they support "reasonable safeguards" for minors and have pointed to product changes — such as updated crisis-response prompts and parental controls — as evidence of good-faith efforts to address the underlying concerns independent of legislation.
segments.tr: 複数の企業は未成年者への「合理的な保護」をサポートしていると公開声明し、危機対応プロンプトの更新と親による制御などの製品変更を、立法とは無関係に根本的な懸念に対処する誠意ある努力の証拠として指摘しています。

segments.src: ## The Core Tension: Definitions as Policy
segments.tr: ## 核心的な緊張：政策としての定義

segments.src: Legal analysts who study technology regulation note that this dynamic is not unique to AI chatbots.
segments.tr: テクノロジー規制を研究する法律アナリストは、このダイナミクスがAIチャットボットに特有ではないことを指摘しています。

segments.src: In sectors from social media to data privacy, definitional language has long been a primary battleground precisely because it is less visible to the public than headline mandates.
segments.tr: ソーシャルメディアからデータプライバシーまでのセクターでは、定義上の言語は長らく主要な戦場であり、これは見出しの命令よりも一般大衆に目立たないからです。

segments.src: A bill that bans "harmful design features targeting minors" reads very differently depending on how "companion chatbot" or "AI system" is legally defined — and those definitions are frequently drafted with direct input from the companies whose products will be judged against them.
segments.tr: 「未成年者を対象とした有害な設計機能」を禁止する法案は、「コンパニオンチャットボット」または「AIシステム」がどのように法的に定義されるかに応じて非常に異なって読まれます—そしてこれらの定義は、その製品が判断される企業からの直接的な入力でしばしばドラフトされます。

segments.src: Child safety advocates argue that this makes independent, expert-led drafting essential, and several groups have called for state attorneys general or dedicated technical advisory bodies — rather than industry lobbyists — to have the final say on scope-defining language.
segments.tr: 児童安全擁護者は、これが独立した専門家主導のドラフト作成を不可欠にしていることを主張し、いくつかのグループは、業界ロビイストではなく州司法長官または専任の技術顧問機関が範囲定義言語について最終的な決定権を持つことを求めています。

segments.src: Some legislators have echoed that call, while others maintain that collaboration with industry, conducted transparently and subject to public comment, remains a normal and necessary part of writing workable tech policy.
segments.tr: 一部の議員がその呼びかけに応じた一方で、他の議員は、透明性を持って実施され、公開コメントの対象となる業界とのコラボレーションが、機能的なテク政策を作成する際の通常かつ必要な部分であることを主張しています。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 次に何が起こるか

segments.src: None of the state bills reviewed have been shown to eliminate accountability outright, and several include provisions — such as private rights of action or mandatory incident reporting — that would apply broadly regardless of how narrowly a product is defined.
segments.tr: レビューされた州の法案の中に、説明責任を完全に排除するものはなく、いくつかは製品がいかに狭く定義されるかに関わらず広く適用される条項（例えば、私有訴訟権または強制的な事件報告など）を含んでいます。

segments.src: Litigation stemming from the teen death cases is also proceeding separately from the legislative process and could shape industry practices regardless of what state law ultimately requires.
segments.tr: 十代死亡事件に起因する訴訟も立法プロセスとは別に進行しており、州法が最終的に何を要求するかに関わらず業界慣行を形作る可能性があります。

segments.src: For now, the story emerging from statehouses is less about whether AI chatbots will be regulated — nearly every stakeholder, including the companies themselves, now says some rules are inevitable — and more about who gets to write the fine print that decides how far those rules actually reach.
segments.tr: 現在のところ、州議会から浮かび上がるストーリーは、AIチャットボットが規制されるかどうかについてというより（ほぼ全てのステークホルダー、企業自身を含めて、いくつかのルールは避けられないと言っています）、これらのルールが実際にどこまで到達するかを決定する細部を書く権利を持つのが誰かについてです。

segments.src: As more states finalize their bills in the coming months, the exemption language negotiated behind the scenes may end up mattering as much as the headlines announcing new protections for young users.
segments.tr: 今後数ヶ月間、より多くの州が法案を最終化する中で、裏で交渉された免除言語は、若いユーザーのための新しい保護を発表する見出しと同じくらい重要になる可能性があります。

segments.tr: Theo các thống kê gần đây, khoảng 15 tiểu bang đã đề xuất hoặc thúc đẩy các luật nhằm vào an toàn chatbot — các biện pháp từ giao thức chuyển hướng khủng hoảng bắt buộc và yêu cầu xác minh tuổi đến các quy tắc công bố yêu cầu các bot xác định rõ ràng bản thân là không phải con người.

segments.src: Lawmakers in both parties have described the effort as an urgent, bipartisan response to a technology that is evolving faster than the legal system meant to oversee it.
segments.tr: Các nhà lập pháp của cả hai đảng đã mô tả nỗ lực này như một phản ứng khẩn cấp, song phương đối với một công nghệ đang phát triển nhanh hơn hệ thống pháp lý được dự định để giám sát nó.

segments.src: ## Where Industry Involvement Comes In
segments.tr: ## Sự Tham gia của Ngành Công nghệ Bắt đầu Từ Đâu

segments.src: What has drawn fresh scrutiny is not the existence of these bills, but how some of them are being written.
segments.tr: Điều đã thu hút sự kiểm tra lại là không phải sự tồn tại của các dự luật này, mà là cách một số trong số chúng được soạn thảo.

segments.src: Journalists and policy researchers who have reviewed lobbying disclosures and draft legislative language in several states report that major technology companies — including Google and other large AI developers — have been actively engaged in shaping the bills, not just opposing them outright.
segments.tr: Các nhà báo và nhà nghiên cứu chính sách đã xem xét các công bố lôi kéo và dự thảo ngôn ngữ lập pháp ở nhiều tiểu bang báo cáo rằng các công ty công nghệ lớn — bao gồm Google và các nhà phát triển AI lớn khác — đã tích cực tham gia vào việc hình thành các dự luật, không chỉ phản đối chúng một cách trực tiếp.

segments.src: According to this reporting, the industry's approach has often centered less on blocking regulation altogether and more on negotiating the fine print: definitions of what counts as a "companion chatbot," carve-outs for general-purpose assistants, and exemption clauses that determine which products actually fall under a given law's scope.
segments.tr: Theo báo cáo này, cách tiếp cận của ngành thường tập trung ít hơn vào việc chặn quy định hoàn toàn và nhiều hơn vào việc đàm phán chi tiết: định nghĩa những gì được coi là "chatbot bạn đồng hành," ngoại lệ cho các trợ lý đa mục đích, và các điều khoản miễn trừ xác định sản phẩm nào thực sự thuộc phạm vi của luật nhất định.

segments.src: Critics argue that this kind of technical drafting can be just as consequential as a bill's headline provisions, since narrow or ambiguous definitions can leave the most widely used consumer AI products largely untouched even as smaller, less-resourced companion-app makers face the full weight of new compliance rules.
segments.tr: Những nhà phê bình lập luận rằng loại soạn thảo kỹ thuật này có thể có hậu quả tương đương với các điều khoản tiêu đề của dự luật, vì các định nghĩa hẹp hoặc mơ hồ có thể để các sản phẩm AI tiêu dùng được sử dụng rộng rãi nhất phần lớn không bị ảnh hưởng ngay cả khi các nhà sản xuất ứng dụng bạn đồng hành nhỏ hơn, ít tài nguyên hơn phải chịu toàn bộ trọng lượng của các quy tắc tuân thủ mới.

segments.src: Industry representatives have pushed back on characterizations that suggest improper influence.
segments.tr: Các đại diện ngành công nghệ đã phản đối các nhận xét cho rằng có ảnh hưởng không phù hợp.

segments.src: Trade groups representing major tech firms have said their involvement in the legislative process is standard practice for any regulated industry, and that technical input from companies with deep engineering expertise helps lawmakers avoid writing rules that are unworkable, vague, or that inadvertently sweep in unrelated software like customer-service bots, search features, or productivity tools.
segments.tr: Các nhóm thương mại đại diện cho các công ty công nghệ lớn cho biết sự tham gia của họ trong quá trình lập pháp là thực tiễn tiêu chuẩn cho bất kỳ ngành được quy định nào, và đầu vào kỹ thuật từ các công ty có chuyên môn kỹ thuật sâu giúp các nhà lập pháp tránh viết các quy tắc không thể thực hiện được, mơ hồ, hoặc vô tình bao gồm phần mềm không liên quan như chatbot hỗ trợ khách hàng, tính năng tìm kiếm, hoặc các công cụ năng suất.

segments.src: Several companies have publicly stated they support "reasonable safeguards" for minors and have pointed to product changes — such as updated crisis-response prompts and parental controls — as evidence of good-faith efforts to address the underlying concerns independent of legislation.
segments.tr: Một số công ty đã công khai tuyên bố hỗ trợ "các biện pháp bảo vệ hợp lý" cho trẻ vị thành niên và đã chỉ ra các thay đổi sản phẩm — chẳng hạn như cập nhật lời nhắc phản ứng khủng hoảng và kiểm soát của cha mẹ — là bằng chứng của những nỗ lực lành tâm để giải quyết các mối lo ngại cơ bản độc lập với lập pháp.

segments.src: ## The Core Tension: Definitions as Policy
segments.tr: ## Căng thẳng Cốt lõi: Định nghĩa như Chính sách

segments.src: Legal analysts who study technology regulation note that this dynamic is not unique to AI chatbots.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích pháp lý nghiên cứu quy định công nghệ lưu ý rằng động lực này không phải là duy nhất đối với chatbot AI.

segments.src: In sectors from social media to data privacy, definitional language has long been a primary battleground precisely because it is less visible to the public than headline mandates.
segments.tr: Trong các lĩnh vực từ phương tiện truyền thông xã hội đến quyền riêng tư dữ liệu, ngôn ngữ định nghĩa từ lâu đã là một chiến trường chính chính xác vì nó ít được công chúng thấy hơn so với các lệnh tiêu đề.

segments.src: A bill that bans "harmful design features targeting minors" reads very differently depending on how "companion chatbot" or "AI system" is legally defined — and those definitions are frequently drafted with direct input from the companies whose products will be judged against them.
segments.tr: Một dự luật cấm "các tính năng thiết kế có hại nhắm tới trẻ vị thành niên" đọc rất khác nhau tùy thuộc vào cách "chatbot bạn đồng hành" hoặc "hệ thống AI" được định nghĩa pháp lý — và những định nghĩa đó thường được soạn thảo với đầu vào trực tiếp từ các công ty có sản phẩm sẽ được đánh giá so với chúng.

segments.src: Child safety advocates argue that this makes independent, expert-led drafting essential, and several groups have called for state attorneys general or dedicated technical advisory bodies — rather than industry lobbyists — to have the final say on scope-defining language.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ an toàn trẻ em lập luận rằng điều này làm cho soạn thảo độc lập do các chuyên gia dẫn đầu là cần thiết, và một số nhóm đã kêu gọi các công tố viên tổng quát tiểu bang hoặc các cơ quan tư vấn kỹ thuật chuyên dụng — thay vì các nhà lôi kéo công nghiệp — để có quyền nói cuối cùng về ngôn ngữ định nghĩa phạm vi.

segments.src: Some legislators have echoed that call, while others maintain that collaboration with industry, conducted transparently and subject to public comment, remains a normal and necessary part of writing workable tech policy.
segments.tr: Một số nhà lập pháp đã lặp lại cuộc kêu gọi đó, trong khi những người khác duy trì rằng hợp tác với ngành, được tiến hành một cách minh bạch và phải chịu bình luận công khai, vẫn là một phần bình thường và cần thiết của việc viết chính sách công nghệ có thể thực hiện được.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì Sắp tới

segments.src: None of the state bills reviewed have been shown to eliminate accountability outright, and several include provisions — such as private rights of action or mandatory incident reporting — that would apply broadly regardless of how narrowly a product is defined.
segments.tr: Không có dự luật tiểu bang nào được xem xét được chứng minh loại bỏ trách nhiệm giải trình hoàn toàn, và một số bao gồm các điều khoản — chẳng hạn như quyền hành động riêng hoặc báo cáo sự cố bắt buộc — sẽ được áp dụng rộng rãi bất kể sản phẩm được định nghĩa hẹp như thế nào.

segments.src: Litigation stemming from the teen death cases is also proceeding separately from the legislative process and could shape industry practices regardless of what state law ultimately requires.
segments.tr: Các vụ kiện phát sinh từ các trường hợp tử vong của thiếu niên cũng đang diễn ra riêng biệt từ quá trình lập pháp và có thể định hình các thực hành công nghiệp bất kể luật tiểu bang cuối cùng yêu cầu gì.

segments.src: For now, the story emerging from statehouses is less about whether AI chatbots will be regulated — nearly every stakeholder, including the companies themselves, now says some rules are inevitable — and more about who gets to write the fine print that decides how far those rules actually reach.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, câu chuyện phát sinh từ các tòa nhà tiểu bang ít hơn về việc liệu chatbot AI có được điều chỉnh hay không — gần như mọi bên liên quan, bao gồm cả các công ty, hiện nay đều nói rằng một số quy tắc là không thể tránh khỏi — và nhiều hơn về ai được viết các chi tiết nhỏ xác định những quy tắc đó thực sự đạt tới mức nào.

segments.src: As more states finalize their bills in the coming months, the exemption language negotiated behind the scenes may end up mattering as much as the headlines announcing new protections for young users.
segments.tr: Khi ngày càng nhiều tiểu bang hoàn thiện các dự luật của họ trong những tháng tới, ngôn ngữ miễn trừ được đàm phán đằng sau hậu trường có thể kết thúc quan trọng như nhau với các tiêu đề thông báo về các bảo vệ mới cho người dùng trẻ.
